text:
Oliver Tran: Brain dump  thinking about a 5-week pilot for an 'aftercare concierge' to improve PM follow-through. low friction, clear escalation.
Priya Bhandari: can you define concierge vs what we already have?
Oliver Tran: not a new tracker. concierge = role that owns follow-through workflow: quick checks, one weekly drop-in, and a tiny dashboard badge for repeats.
Noah Rivera: i like the badge idea. can we auto-add a 'repeat' badge when the same component shows up 2x in 60d?
Camille Park: yes. and add a 'stalled' badge when an action is >7d with no updates.
oncall-bot: automation: "aftercare-concierge-pilot" -> posts DM at 48h and 7d to owners
Priya Bhandari: suggested cadence: day0 ack, 48h status, day7 unblock or escalate, day14 close or formal escal. one weekly 20m drop-in for active owners.
Oliver Tran: communication rule: all nudges are DMs only. post to channel only for escalations with a one-line reason. low noise.
Noah Rivera: templated DM examples? short please.
Camille Park: here's two we can use:
```
48h DM: "hi <owner>, quick status on PM action #<id>? blockers? ETA?"
7d DM: "hi <owner>, action #<id> is 7d old. can you confirm plan or request escalation?"
```
Priya Bhandari: nice. metrics to track: median days-to-close, % closed <=14d, #repeat-badges/week, %stalled. dashboard should be weekly.
Oliver Tran: concierge rota: 1-week blocks, volunteers first, fallback to ops lead if empty 48h before start. concierge only runs follow-ups, not IC duties.
Noah Rivera: i'll prototype a small script to compute repeat and stalled badges from incident tags + last-update-ts. output CSV for dashboard. ETA: 4 business days.
Camille Park: i'll build the sheet with columns: owner | action | created-ts | last-update | badge | due | notes. add a chart of time-to-close.
Priya Bhandari: pilot scope: infra + platform teams only, 5 weeks. opt-in owners for first run. review at end and decide next steps.
oncall-bot: reminder: runbook uploaded -> /docs/incidents/aftercare-concierge-runbook.md
Oliver Tran: escalation path: owner -> concierge -> oncall lead -> eng manager. concierge escalates after 72h blocked.
Noah Rivera: one question: will concierges have access to the action tracker edit rights?
Camille Park: yes, edit rights for concierge role so they can update status and add notes; owners retain primary ownership.
Priya Bhandari: action list: Oliver draft pilot doc + rota; Noah -> badge script; Camille -> sheet + dashboard; I'll write concise owner playbook (one page).
Oliver Tran: aiming to start pilot Monday. low overhead, clear measurements. objections?
Noah Rivera: none. :+1:
Camille Park: :thumbsup:
Priya Bhandari: :+1:
Oliver Tran: thanks everyone  will post signup and the one-pager tomorrow morning.
